detail.title: HDMI 2.0 Cable with Blue Metal Cap - 20 Meters
detail.overview: The Ant Esports AEH120 is a 20-metre HDMI 2.0 cable finished with a distinctive blue metal connector cap and 24K gold-plated contacts for reliable, corrosion-resistant connections over time. Rated for 18Gbps bandwidth, it supports the full range of HDTV resolutions and refresh rates for sharp, lag-free video and audio across the longest common runs, ideal for large venues, auditoriums or multi-room installations. Its sturdy build and premium connector finish ensure dependable performance wherever a source device and display are placed far apart.
